sample-01.text: Hey, I picked up the cups in these pictures for the shop, and I paid cash from the till. Could you add them to stock and take the payment out? The scissors and the other bits are just things we already had.

sample-02.text: Hey, those bottles in the photos have just sold. The customer paid cash, so that money's in the till now. Can you mark them off? The chocolates are still here, so leave those as they are.

sample-03.text: Hey, I was going to restock the pencils in that first photo... actually, leave those alone for now. Someone bought the forks in the other photo and paid cash. Take those off the shelf count and put the payment in the till. The spoons weren't part of the sale.
